details.note: The skin is a touch brighter again: w17K (300,400) L194 -> 197, w17A (500,450) L179 -> 181, against KN41 near L194. There is no tiling, and the fastener rows and seams are unchanged and correct. The w10 TE grime band (#66686b, 0.24 m) is barely visible at window range, which is fine because KN41 is clean. The near-far gradient is still reversed, though the gap narrowed. In w19A the near inboard flap (600,440) is L161 (w10 158) and the far fixed skin (680,195) is L178 (w10 185), (620,250) L167. KN41 runs near 196 -> far 129-145. The steeper albedo ramp (1.10 -> 0.86) and the rougher paint (0.72) took about 10 L off the far skin. The rest is the albedo-independent grazing env term.
Unchanged and correct. The plates step against the skin and the gap hierarchy matches KN41.

This is the big win of the round. With the loft outside-out, the K-side pods now read as solid lit bodies: a bright crown (w26K (590,339) L217) over an even flank (L168-170) closing on a darker keel line (L98). That matches the _7250 structure: top 224-244, flank 124-149, belly 75-84. The bright keel band and the grey sock are gone (rb11/z26K.png r10 against r11). c_canoe_side shows a lit top facet L194 over a flank L131 -> 123. Residuals: (1) The flanks are flat. In w26K there is no grade down the flank: flank/top is 0.78 against about 0.55 in _7250, and the keel reads as a thin dark rim rather than a shaded belly. (2) From the A side (w19A) the flanks are a uniform L84 slab, 0.52 of the near skin (KN41 0.58-0.84 with a grade), so they still read as flat grey teeth, though less charcoal (w10 L78). (3) The new near-zero tip ring pinches into a faceted cone. In c_canoes_left both tips show a hard diagonal light/dark split and a 2-3 px black point (rb11/ztips.png). It is studio-only and invisible at window range.

issues.detail: wing near-far gradient still reversed in w19A
issues.problem: The near flap is still darker than the far fixed skin: 161 against 178. KN41 shows the near skin brightest (196), falling to 129-145 far out. The albedo levers are nearly spent (ramp 1.10 -> 0.86, rough 0.72). The far skin is lit by the grazing env term mix(skyBot, skyTop*1.2) times Fresnel, which ignores the baked vertex colour.
issues.fix: Exterior (own file): roughness is per-add, so the ramp cannot reach the env term from here. The remaining own-file lever is to steepen the ramp further to lerp(1.12, 0.80, clamp((sp - 6) / 16, 0, 1)) and drop the movable-panel base to 0.95 so the near flaps stay above 0.95 x near skin. Lighting hand-off (04_shaders.js exterior branch): scale specEnv by the albedo ratio, `specEnv *= clamp(dot(v_col.rgb, vec3(0.333)) / max(dot(matBase, vec3(0.333)), 1e-3), 0.6, 1.1)`, and sample the env for R.y > 0.3 toward the zenith colour (deep blue, darker) instead of skyTop*1.2.

issues.detail: canoe flanks flat (no grade), thin dark keel rim
issues.problem: The flanks are one tone from the crown edge to the keel: w26K L168-170 over 50 px, w19A L84 across the whole tooth. _7250 grades 149 -> 75 down the flank, and KN41 grades 149 -> 103. The bake 0.5 + 0.3 smooth(-0.9, -0.1, n.y) + 0.2 smooth(0.1, 0.4, n.y) is flat for n.y in (-0.1, 0.1), which covers most of the chined flank.
issues.fix: 11_exterior.js canoe shadeVerts (~l.443): add a height term so the flank grades top -> bottom, e.g. `(p, n) => (0.5 + 0.3 * smooth(-0.9, -0.1, n[1]) + 0.2 * smooth(0.1, 0.4, n[1])) * lerp(0.72, 1.0, smooth(-0.85, -0.1, (p[1] - topY)))`, with topY the pod's top at that station (or a simple fraction of the local depth via p[1] relative to the wing lower surface: `wingAt(cs, x, side, -1)[1]`).
